archive.catalogue_description: PLEASE NOTE: This is an EXPERIMENTAL map, the reason why I’m realeasing it is to see how the community would react to this map’s style of play. I am anticipating criticism however please tell me what you dislike AND like about the map (It will greatly help me!). Also if you have ANY SUGGESTIONS please comment them below (It would also help me a lot). Thank you! [/b] (If the map does not load through the shortcut then when in-game go to MODS -> aliendefense and then launch it) MAIN DETAILS (PLEASE READ): BUILT IN (ESTIMATION): Over 1 month DIFFICULTY: Medium/Hard RECCOMMENDED NUMBER OF PLAYERS: 2+ PERKS: Deadshot Daiquiri, PHD Flopper, Stamin-Up, Speed Cola, Double Tap 2.0, Mule Kick DESCRIPTION OF THE MAP: I created this map because I thought it’d be a fun little twist on the original progression formula you see in 99% of maps these days. I would be really interested to see who has survived to the highest round on this map so please comment below your highscore! The story goes like this (if there even is a story): Some people on a parallel earth invented a teleport to our earth in a desperate attempt to stop the planet from being overrun from zombie-aliens (just go with it), after they realise the how the virus could spread to a different world, they must defend this portal until a way is found to shut it down completely – even if it means imploding the planet.
